provenance.base_context: 10,000 horizon-stratified causal rows; base refit <=2015; every row requires 3 contiguous observed fixes

provenance.corrector: TabPFN-3.5 full-X+residual model, predictive mean output; original-X-only TabPFN and same-full-X ridge controls
provenance.causal: Latest verified same-h j<=t-h; residual age<=48h; missing lag uses zero plus availability=0, not future labels
provenance.coverage: Historical empirical coverage. Shape fit 2018, quantile 2019, no exchangeability guarantee under drift.
provenance.efficiency: Joint tangent-coordinate volume; not intrinsic spherical area/volume. Posthoc matched threshold uses test labels only as diagnostic; never deployed.

policy.rule: minimum validation MAE; >=1% gain and negative upper storm-bootstrap delta; otherwise weight 0
policy.note: Frozen before computing test errors, coverage or volume. Test predictions may be cached; test outcomes never select policy.

bootstrap_note: Exploratory 95% percentile intervals, 2,000 paired whole-storm resamples, seed 20261021; inter-storm dependence and drift not modeled.
